tools.name: search_residences
tools.description: Find private seniors' residences (RPA) on the island of Montréal from Québec's official register, filtered by place, needs, category or name. Returns each residence's address, phone, category, key services, register record and, when there is one, a guide page on residences-montreal.com.

tools.name: get_residence
tools.description: Full record of one Montréal private seniors' residence from Québec's official register: category, operator, units, services (meals, help, personal assistance, nursing, memory care), building features (elevators, sprinklers, generator, air conditioning), phone and links.

tools.name: compare_residences
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 Montréal seniors' residences side by side from the official register: category, operator, size, services, building features and links.

tools.name: explain_rpa_categories
tools.description: What Québec's four categories of private seniors' residences (RPA) mean, who each is for, and what the service types (meals, domestic help, security, recreation, personal assistance, nursing care) cover, from the certification regulation.

tools.name: costs_and_help
tools.description: What it costs to live in a seniors' residence in Québec: what the register says about RPA prices, the 2026 maximum contribution for a public CHSLD, and guides on costs and financial help on residences-montreal.com.

tools.name: find_guides
tools.description: Search the practical guides on residences-montreal.com (choosing a residence, costs, moving, neighbourhoods, care levels) and return titles, summaries and links.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: The cities and neighbourhoods of the island of Montréal with residences in the register, with counts, and the neighbourhood guides on residences-montreal.com.
